title: Modelovanje prijetnji, lanac snabdijevanja i obuka
summary: Modelovanje prijetnji (četiri pitanja, DFD i granice povjerenja, STRIDE, PASTA, VAST, DREAD, Trike, LINDDUN, attack trees, ATT&CK, AI sistemi), upravljanje rizikom lanca snabdijevanja (tampering, krivotvorine, implantati, reputacioni rizik; procjena i monitoring dobavljača, minimalni zahtjevi, SLA, silicon root of trust, PUF, SBOM i VEX) te program svijesti, obuke i edukacije sa security championsima, gamifikacijom, mjerenjem efikasnosti, angažmanom stakeholdera i temama AI, kriptovaluta i blockchaina.
title_en: Threat Modeling, Supply Chain and Training
summary_en: Threat modeling (the four questions, DFDs and trust boundaries, STRIDE, PASTA, VAST, DREAD, Trike, LINDDUN, attack trees, ATT&CK, AI systems), supply chain risk management (tampering, counterfeits, implants, reputational risk; supplier assessment and monitoring, minimum requirements, SLAs, silicon root of trust, PUF, SBOM and VEX), and a security awareness, training and education program with security champions, gamification, effectiveness measurement, stakeholder engagement, and AI, cryptocurrency and blockchain topics.
